pdf_page_count takes the password of an encrypted PDF

```python title="Python"
from pathlib import Path
from xberg import pdf_page_count

def main() -> None:
    pdf_bytes = Path("pdf/password_protected.pdf").read_bytes()
    password = ""
    result = pdf_page_count(pdf_bytes, password)
    print(result)

main()
```
